Pauses a channel. The sound stays where it is until [ResumeChannel](ResumeChannel) continues it. A paused channel is still reported as playing by [ChannelPlaying](ChannelPlaying).

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
LoopSound snd
Local ch = PlaySound(snd)
Delay 500
PauseChannel ch
Delay 500
ResumeChannel ch
Delay 500
StopChannel ch
```
@param channel  A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound) or [PlayMusic](PlayMusic).
@gap A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out. A channel that is over is fine everywhere, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
